headline: Nesthy Petecio Exits Asian Games in Women’s 60kg Quarterfinals
seoTitle: Nesthy Petecio Exits Asian Games in 60kg Quarterfinals | FMB News
seoDescription: Nesthy Petecio lost by unanimous decision to China's Yang Chengyu in the 2026 Asian Games women's 60kg quarterfinals.
deck: Petecio lost by unanimous decision to China’s Yang Chengyu, ending her women’s 60kg campaign before the medal rounds.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Nesthy Petecio's 2026 Asian Games campaign ended in the women's 60kg quarterfinals after a unanimous-decision loss to China's Yang Chengyu on Monday.
Because the loss came before the semifinals, Petecio did not secure a medal in the event.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Petecio reached the quarterfinals after stopping Jordan's Mays Alreem Abukhadijah in the second round of their opening bout on September 26.
A quarterfinal appearance is not an assured medal in Asian Games boxing; the podium places begin with the semifinalists.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The result ends the two-time Olympic medalist's bid for an Asian Games podium finish in Aichi-Nagoya.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Philippine boxing remains in medal contention through other athletes, including Carlo Paalam, who reached the men's 55kg semifinals.

verificationNotes: The Game recorded Petecio's unanimous-decision quarterfinal loss to Yang Chengyu.
GMA Sports independently reported that Petecio lost to her Chinese opponent and exited the Games.
The article explicitly states that no medal was secured because the loss came before the semifinals.
No publisher-owned event photograph was reused; the FMB-owned editorial fallback is non-documentary.
